subject: Audit period boundaries and point-in-time evidence for Acorn Health
messages:
From: Sarah Smith <sarah.smith@acornhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acornhealth.com
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 report boundary question: coverage for Aug–Oct 2025?

Hi Evelyn,

Quick question as we prepare for our vendor assessment: we have a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report labeled 'Period: 2025-04-01 to 2025-09-30' and want to confirm two things for our audit calendar:

1) Does Redwood consider the report "inclusive" of 2025-09-30 only, or do you also provide supporting artifacts for adjacent point-in-time checks (for example, configuration snapshots or incident logs as of 2025-10-31) via a bridge letter?
2) If we need a bridge letter or supplemental statement to cover 2025-10-31, can you confirm turnaround time and whether that will include evidence (e.g., exported config, change logs) or only a signed attestation?

For context: our compliance window asks for continuous coverage through 2025-10-31, and we want to understand what we can provide to our internal auditors.

Thanks — appreciate the quick clarification.

Sarah
Sarah Smith
Security & Compliance Manager
Acorn Health
[sarah.smith@acornhealth.com]

[Attachment: acorn_request_screenshot.png (png, 120KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Smith <sarah.smith@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report boundary question: coverage for Aug–Oct 2025?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front, then details and next steps:

- The SOC 2 Type II report you have (2025-04-01 to 2025-09-30) covers control operating effectiveness for that period only; the report is point-bounded by the dates listed.
- We can provide a bridge letter to extend the attestation forward to 2025-10-31 to cover your requested window; bridge letters are signed attestations from our auditor and typically reference any material control changes.

Follow-ups we need from you so we can scope the bridge letter and any evidence package:

1) Do you need an attestation only, or do you require exported artifacts (config snapshots, access listings, incident/uptime logs) as part of your submission?
2) Which systems in-scope for your review (app API, embedding pipeline, admin console)? If you list the minimal set we can prioritize export.

Operational notes:
- If attestation-only: we can produce a draft bridge letter and route to our auditor for signature in ~3 business days.
- If evidence needed: depending on the systems requested, collecting and sanitizing exports can take 5–10 business days. We can provide redacted logs and a short index to explain each artifact.

I’m looping in Karthik (Audit liaison) and David (Ops lead) to confirm feasibility and provide a draft. Attaching the SOC 2 summary you referenced and a bridge letter template so you can confirm the form you prefer.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com]

[Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (pdf, 2.4MB); bridge_letter_template_draft.docx (docx, 45KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Smith <sarah.smith@acornhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report boundary question: coverage for Aug–Oct 2025?

Hi all — adding the auditor confirmation and a few implementation details.

• Confirmed with Clearpath Audit (our third-party auditor): the SOC 2 Type II report period is 2025-04-01 through 2025-09-30. That means September 30th is the last day of the covered operating period.

• Bridge letter scope: Clearpath is able to issue a bridge letter that attests there were no control exceptions between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31, subject to Redwood providing the following artifacts for their review:
  - Access control export for 2025-10-31 (IAM list + role mappings)
  - Change/configuration snapshot for the API and admin console as of 2025-10-31
  - Incident log summary for Oct 2025 (if any incidents occurred)

• Timing: if Redwood provides the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2025-11-12), Clearpath expects to issue a signed bridge letter within 3 business days after receiving sanitized evidence (assuming no issues discovered). If we only need an attestation without artifacts, they can provide a signed bridge letter in ~2 business days.

Evelyn / David — can you confirm availability to package those three artifacts and any redaction guidance? Sarah — will an attestation-only bridge letter suffice, or do you need the artifacts attached?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Audit & Controls
Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com]

From: Sarah Smith <sarah.smith@acornhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, security@acornhealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report boundary question: coverage for Aug–Oct 2025?

Evelyn / Karthik — thank you both, that is very helpful.

We can accept the attestation-only bridge letter in the short term; our internal auditors prefer artifacts but will accept an attestation if turnaround is faster. For now, please: 

1) Send the attestation-only bridge letter (signed) as a PDF via DocuSign or secure link.
2) If Redwood can also collect the three artifacts you listed, please provide an ETA — we'll flag that as supplemental evidence and may follow up with specific redaction questions.

Expected timeline from our side: we need the signed bridge letter by 2025-11-20 to keep our vendor review on schedule. If you can provide the attestation-only letter within the next 5 business days, that will work.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Sarah Smith
Security & Compliance Manager
Acorn Health
[sarah.smith@acornhealth.com]
